title: Green Shutters and Lemons (المصاريع الخضراء والليمون)

scenes.title: ورشة طلاء داخل الممرّ
scenes.summary: On rainy Monday morning, Caleb sets up cross-breeze airflow in the wide back hallway so Hannah and Graham can paint the four shutters indoors.

scenes.title: نظارة خضراء
scenes.summary: Arthur insists on painting one shutter slat to help, immediately getting a streak of green paint on the reading glasses perched on his forehead.

scenes.title: نغمة الرّي الوسطى تغنّي من جديد
scenes.summary: On Tuesday morning, Graham reseats the tiny brass pin and tunes the middle strings while Evelyn tests middle D on the walnut piano.

scenes.title: تعليق المصاريع الخضراء
scenes.summary: In Tuesday's bright afternoon sun, Graham, Caleb, and Hannah hang the freshly painted green shutters around Room 9's arched glass.

scenes.title: لافتة الترحيب
scenes.summary: At the front desk, Hannah designs a simple welcome sign and cafe menu card that Arthur and Evelyn check line by line.

scenes.title: انتبهي للمقعد المنخفض
scenes.summary: In the Tuesday evening kitchen, Tessa reaches for the big copper teapot on the high shelf and twists her right ankle stepping off the low wooden stool.

scenes.title: ثلج ووسائد وأوامر
scenes.summary: Hannah and Owen prop Tessa's ankle comfortably on two pillows while Tessa writes out step-by-step Wednesday baking jobs for the whole crew.

scenes.title: إحدى الجرّتين ملح!
scenes.summary: Late Tuesday night while tidying the counter for dawn baking, Arthur refills two unlabeled white ceramic jars, leaving Hannah and Graham unsure which is sugar and which is salt.
